description: COMPAT ENTRY (adapter) — same product as generate_scene with scene='crud' (byte-identical), kept for hosts that already call this name. Use it for ANY request that involves a list/table, CRUD, search + results, or multiple es-plus pieces working together. Your ONE job is to fill `surfaces`: set query/table/form field lists and the dialog list to match what the request implies (any subset is valid — table-only, query+table, table+add/edit, full CRUD, etc.). A `surfaces.dialog` entry is either a canned key ('add'/'edit'/'view') or a full object `{ key, title?, width?, fullscreen?, formItems? }` when the request names a custom dialog id/title/width or a per-dialog field list. Routing is then deterministic: table-bearing requests compile through the golden-covered single generator; no-table subsets emit self-contained fragments. Do NOT manually orchestrate generate_form/generate_table/generate_dialog for a composite page — fill surfaces here and let the routing compose them. When the user wants several standalone pieces assembled into one page (not a CRUD page), call generate_composition instead. Use the standalone tools only for an explicit single-component ask or to embed a fragment next to non-es-plus components. Optional config knobs — tableOptions / formLayout / operationColumn / tableBtns / toolbarBtns / expandConfig / treeConfig / mergeConfig — may be set alongside `surfaces`; each is forwarded verbatim into the composed config, so fill them only when the request names those specifics. A no-table request whose only surface is `dialog` emits one JSX composable PER dialog entry (named use<Key>Dialog): each entry's `formItems` overrides the shared form/query body, its `title` becomes open()'s default title, and its `width`/`fullscreen` are applied. Because the dialog body is a JSX render, that path needs a JSX plugin; if the host wants a self-contained dialog with NO JSX dependency, call generate_dialog with mode:'component' instead. When the client supports MCP structured output, the artifact envelope is also returned as `structuredContent`; the text content is unchanged.

tableBtns.description: Table toolbar buttons rendered above EsTable, e.g. [{ name: "导出", actionType: "export", position: "left" }]. Canonical keys are `name` + `actionType` + `position`; the legacy aliases `label`/`action` are accepted and normalized.

tableOptions.description: Table options, forwarded verbatim into the composed config's `tableOptions` block (border/stripe/rowkey/heightType/tabHeight/height/multiSelect/emptyText/size/defaultSort/leftText/engine/virtual/editConfig/configTableOut/tableOptions.treeConfig/tableOptions.expandConfig/…). The full key set and per-key semantics are the same as `StructuredCrudConfig.tableOptions`; unknown keys are rejected.

cachePageSelection.description: Persist the checkbox selection across page changes (needs a stable rowkey). Default true at runtime; set false to reset selection on page change.

columnConfig.description: vxe column config, e.g. { resizable: true, drag: true, showOverflow: 'tooltip' }. Advanced: only with engine:'vxe'.

configTableOut.description: Map the LIST API response onto table semantics when the backend does not use the default flat shape. Default mapping is { total: "records", tableData: "rows", pageSize: "pageSize", current: "pageNo" }. Each value is the FLAT response key (no deep paths — the component only reads top-level keys). e.g. a backend returning { list: [...], count: N } → { tableData: "list", total: "count" }. Only the keys you set are remapped; omit a key to keep its default.

defaultSort.description: Default sort applied on first render.

editConfig.description: Enable vxe inline editing (AI-09 子项④). vxe engine only — MUST be paired with tableOptions.engine:'vxe'. A cell is only editable when its column also declares `editRender`. An edit writes STRAIGHT into the row object of `:data-source` (the table holds the same row references, so the host also gets `update:dataSource`); `keepSource` is auto-enabled only to keep a snapshot for `revertData()`, it is NOT a private copy. To learn WHICH cell changed and what the previous value was, listen to the `cell-edit` event — `{ row, prop, value, oldValue }`, emitted on blur / row switch in cell mode (one per changed cell in row mode), never for an unchanged cell.

emptyText.description: Text shown when there are no rows (default '暂无数据').

engine.description: Table rendering engine, an alternative to `virtual: true`. 'default' = el-table / a-table / el-table. 'virtual' = vue3 el-table-v2 only; antdv and vue2 have no virtual engine and degrade to a plain table with a warning. 'vxe' = vxe-table, available on ALL THREE targets — vue3 and antdv through their own vxe adapters, and vue2 through @es-plus/vue2's vxe engine. Use 'vxe' for large data on antdv/vue2, where 'virtual' is not available.

estimatedRowHeight.description: Estimated row height for dynamic-height virtual scrolling (vue3 / el-table-v2 only)

expandConfig.description: vxe-only row-expand switch (paired with `expand: true` / an expand column). Distinct from the top-level `expandConfig` (declarative read-only field list honored by all three renderers).

accordion.description: Accordion mode: at most one row expanded at a time.

lazy.description: Lazy-load expand content (vxe only; the loader function itself is a Tier-3 extension point).

exportConfig.description: vxe export config: `true` for defaults, or an object with filename / type ('xlsx'|'csv'|'html'|'xml'|'txt') / useStyle / isColgroup. Advanced: only with engine:'vxe'. Non-CSV formats need the vxe export plugin; the `download` callback is a function and is out of the JSON contract.

footerData.description: Static footer rows, a 2-D array ([row][column]). Advanced: only with engine:'vxe'. The function form `footerMethod` cannot travel in JSON — use `vxeConfig` at runtime.

height.description: Container height used ONLY when heightType is 'height' (ignored for 'auto' / 'maxHeight' — use tabHeight there). Takes precedence over nothing: an explicit tabHeight always wins.

heightType.description: How the container height is applied: 'height' = fixed height (value from `height`, or `tabHeight` if set); 'maxHeight' = capped at `tabHeight` (a `height` value is IGNORED); 'auto' = no container height constraint. Default 'auto'.

keepSource.description: Keep a pre-edit snapshot of each row so revertData() / getUpdateRecords() / getInsertRecords() work. Auto-enabled when editConfig is set. Advanced: vxe inline editing only.

keyboardConfig.description: vxe keyboard navigation. Advanced: only consumed with engine:'vxe', typically together with editConfig.

isArrow.description: Arrow keys move the cell focus.

isEdit.description: Any printable character enters edit mode.

isTab.description: Tab moves to the next cell.

leftText.description: Text shown on the left side of the table toolbar.

localPagination.description: Paginate already-fetched data client-side instead of requesting each page from the API.

mouseConfig.description: vxe cell-selection mode (`{ selected: true }` enables click-to-select). Advanced: only with engine:'vxe'.

selected.description: Click a cell to highlight/select it (arrow keys then move it).

overscanCount.description: Buffer rows outside the visible area (vue3 / el-table-v2 only; default 2)

printConfig.description: vxe print config: `true` for defaults, or e.g. { columns: [{ field: 'name' }] }. Advanced: only with engine:'vxe'.

refetchKeepPage.description: Keep the current page when re-fetching (default false). Query/reset still return to page 1.

rowHeight.description: Row height in px for virtual mode (vue3 / el-table-v2 only; default 50)

seqConfig.description: vxe sequence-column config (needs `snIndex: true` or a type:'index' column). Only `startIndex` is JSON-safe — `seqMethod` is a function and stays in the runtime escape hatch. Advanced: only with engine:'vxe'.

showFooter.description: Show the vxe footer row. Advanced: only consumed with engine:'vxe'.

showHeader.description: Show the table header (default true). Set false to hide it.

size.description: Table density. Default 'small' at runtime; el-table and a-table both accept these.

snIndex.description: Render a leading row-index (serial number) column.

sortParam.description: Server-side sorting: when set, the table stops sorting the current page locally and every list request carries { sortField, sortOrder } (order = 'asc' | 'desc'); a header click refetches the SAME page. { field, order } renames the two request keys. Also seeds from defaultSort, so the first request is already sorted. Omit to keep client-side sorting of the current page.

tabHeight.description: Table height consumed for EVERY heightType: under 'height' it overrides `height`; under 'maxHeight' it is the cap. number → px, string → raw CSS value (e.g. '60vh'). Prefer it over `height` whenever a concrete height is needed — it is the only height key that applies when heightType is 'maxHeight'.

toolbarConfig.description: vxe toolbar config (`true` for defaults, or { buttons: [...] } etc.). Advanced: only with engine:'vxe'.

treeConfig.description: vxe-only rich tree config (the SAME-NAME top-level `treeConfig` is the cross-renderer narrow subset; when both are set the generator merges them into tableOptions.treeConfig with the top-level key winning). Use `treeConfig.transform:true + rowField + parentField` to build a tree from FLAT rows; use the top-level `treeConfig` for nested `children` arrays on el-table / a-table.

children.description: @deprecated vxe v4 alias of childrenField; normalized at runtime.

lazy.description: Lazy-load children (vxe only; the loader function itself is a Tier-3 extension point and cannot travel in JSON).

mapChildren.description: Field that caches original children in transform mode (default '_X_ROW_CHILD').

parentField.description: Parent id field for transform mode (default 'parentId').

rowField.description: Row id field for transform mode (default 'id').

transform.description: Build the tree client-side from FLAT rows (needs rowField + parentField). vxe only.

validConfig.description: vxe cell validation feedback (pair with `rules` on the column's editRender). Advanced: only with engine:'vxe'.

autoPos.description: Scroll the first invalid cell into view.

msgMode.description: Show one message or the full message list (default 'single').

virtual.description: Enable virtual scrolling for large datasets. vue3 renders the el-table-v2 engine. antdv and vue2 have NO virtual scrolling: a-table never implemented it and Element UI has no el-table-v2 — both targets warn and render a plain table. treeConfig.description: Declarative tree table ({ childrenField?, expandAll? }) — renders parent/child levels from each row's nested child array (row-key emitted automatically). Distinct from tableOptions.treeConfig (vxe-only). Unknown keys are rejected.

childrenField.description: Key name that holds a row's nested child nodes (default 'children'). Set only when the API nests children under a different key.

expandAll.description: Whether all nodes start expanded (default false).
